newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares set for more falls up to Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares set for more falls up to Greenspan.

text.p: Danish share prices fell on Monday after the long run of record highs ended on Friday, with jitters ahead of U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's Tuesday Humphrey Hawkins' speech pointing to further declines.
"The market is going to be very cautious with buyers holding a low profile, turnover low and more falls expected up to Greenspan's speech," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 1.03 point to 191.09 at 0725 GMT, having closed 3.49 point lower on Friday, ending a 13-consecutive trading day record spree.
